question: Find the largest number which divides 62, 134 and 242 to leave the same reminder in each case.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required number = HCF of pairwise differences

⇒ 134 − 62 = 72

⇒ 242 − 134 = 108

⇒ 242 − 62 = 180

HCF(72, 108, 180) = 36

**∴ Answer = 36**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers = 62, 134, 242

Same remainder when divided by a number

**Formula used:**

If a, b, c leave same remainder, then required number = HCF of (a − b), (b − c), (c − a)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 134 − 62 = 72

⇒ 242 − 134 = 108

⇒ 242 − 62 = 180

⇒ HCF of (72, 108, 180)

⇒ HCF(72,108) = 36

⇒ HCF(36,180) = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Key Concept

Same remainder ⇒ differences are divisible by required number

HCF Usage

Take HCF of all pairwise differences

Quick Tip

You can use any two differences, but using all confirms answer

Application

Useful in remainder and divisibility problems
